pages.description: Create a landscape scientific neural-network framework diagram for 3D seismic fault prediction. Do not place any overall title at the top. Use a left-to-right pipeline with the neural and model core occupying at least 60% of the canvas. LEFT DOMAIN ANCHOR: a compact realistic 3D seismic amplitude cube X in R^(B×1×D×H×W), with a few thin fault-stick annotations and an explicit three-state mask: positive, verified negative, unknown. MAIN COOL-BLUE PATH: show train-only z-score normalization, local discontinuity and neighborhood feature extraction z in R^(N×F), then a balanced logistic pixel classifier with the embedded equation p_base = sigma(w^T z + b). WARM-ORANGE CONTROLLED SIDE PATH: show 3D patch tokens, a SAM-Med3D image encoder as stacked 2.5D cubes, a sparse 3D prompt encoder, and a mask decoder producing p_sam in R^(N×1). CENTRAL FUSION: a compact evidence gate g_3D with the equation p = (1-g_3D)p_base ⊕ g_3D p_sam; depict the gate as grey and closed because continuous 3D development folds and an explicit unknown mask are required. RIGHT OUTPUT: a 3D fault-probability volume and a binary surface mask, with uncertainty/unknown voxels visibly hatched rather than treated as negatives. BOTTOM TRAINING STRIP: group-aware inline blocks -> train-only preprocessing and class weights -> validation threshold selection -> frozen evaluation; show blocked foundation ranking if the 3D legality gate fails. Mark key arrows with X in R^(B×1×D×H×W), z in R^(N×F), and p in [0,1]^N. Use mathematical operators sigma, ⊕ and a gate icon. No experimental metric values, no learning rate, no epochs, no paragraphs.
